expository.title: Expository assistant
expository.subtitle: 5-pass pipeline (panorama → macro → micro → preachable → fidelity) that distinguishes exegetical division from preachable division.

setup.title: Configure the analysis
setup.subtitle: Pick the book and optionally an approximate sermon count. The book's genre and syntax guide each pass.
setup.translationNote: v1.5: the assistant analyzes the translation (RVR1960/ASV) as a surrogate for the original. v1.6 will load Greek/Hebrew text directly.

preachable.preliminaryBanner: These are initial homiletical hypotheses based on a panoramic reading of the text. Refine them after detailed exegetical study ("Create paper from unit" in the series detail). The fields are editable — adjust title, hypothesis, homiletical line and objective at your discretion before creating the series.

fidelity.noIssues: No issues. The proposal is solid.
fidelity.toggleAddressed: Mark as addressed (I edited or will keep this in mind)
fidelity.toggleIgnored: Ignore (I read it but will keep the original division)

create.title: Create the series
create.subtitle: Each preachable unit becomes a planned sermon. The propositions, pastoral objective, and fidelity notes are persisted on every sermon.
create.defaultDescription: Expository series on {{book}}, divided into {{count}} preachable units (v1.5 pipeline).

panorama.title: Book panorama
panorama.subtitle: Identifies genre, purpose, pastoral problem, central theme, movements, key terms.

macro.title: Macrostructure
macro.subtitle: Divides the book into 3-7 macro-sections, each with function within the book's flow.

micro.title: Microstructure
micro.subtitle: Identifies exegetical units within each macro-section, with genre-specific criteria.

preachable.title: Preachable conversion
preachable.subtitle: Decides which units stand alone, combine, or split. Produces exegetical + homiletical proposition + pastoral objective.

fidelity.title: Fidelity review
fidelity.subtitle: Audits preachable units against the methodology's anti-patterns. Advisory output, never destructive.

pericope.title: Pericope assistant
pericope.subtitle: Divide a book into preachable syntactic units and generate the expository series.

panel.title: Detected pericopes
panel.subtitle: Each pericope can become a full exegetical paper. The paper stays linked to the pericope so traceability is preserved.
panel.askFaculty: Ask Faculty with this pericope loaded

setup.title: Configure the division
setup.subtitle: Pick a book and an approximate pericope count. Original-language syntax drives the boundaries.
setup.translationNote: v1: the assistant analyzes the translation (RVR1960/ASV) as a surrogate for the original. v1.5 will load Greek/Hebrew text directly.

review.subtitle: Review, adjust the title or remove the ones you don't want to include.
